label: herbivore
definition: A heterotroph which consumes plants or macroalgae via ingestion through a type of "mouth". Plant or algal matter is broken down through an internal digestion process.

label: symbiotroph
definition: heterotroph that acquires nutrition from a symbiont

label: deposit feeder
definition: Organism that acquires nutrition by consuming particles of organic matter that have settled to the bottom of a body of water.

label: decomposer
definition: heterotroph that obtains nutrition by breaking down dead or decaying organisms or other organic matter

label: predator
definition: A carnivore that actively captures and consumes other animals, causing their immediate or imminent death

label: scavenger
definition: A carnivore that feeds on dead and decaying animal matter

label: insectivore
definition: A predator that primarily eats insects
